veranderings.rede: In the sense of keeping silent, 'stilbly' is written as one word (AWS compound, like stilhou and stilstaan).
'binne' standing alone at the end of the phrase is wooden; 'daarin' is the natural Afrikaans form and keeps the meaning.
One article shared by a singular and a plural noun reads awkwardly; repeating 'die' makes it clear that these are two alternatives.
